task.title: Compare pages in tabs, windows, and sessions

step.cmd: Click the Open child in new tab link. The child page opens in a new tab.
In the newest tab, check that the page reads "PAGE linked".
In a new tab named report, load the report page.
In a new window named settings, load the settings page.
Start a second Firefox session named reviewer, with an 800 by 600 viewport, and load the review page in it.
In the first tab of the first session, check that the page still reads "MULTI-TAB HOME".
Close the child tab, the report tab, the settings window, and the reviewer session.
